Education | U.S. Representative James Walkinshaw <br /> Fairfax schools consistently outperform the rest of Virginia thanks to dedicated teachers, staff, and the County’s investments in student success. But those gains are at risk. Virginia is $3.5 billion below the national average in state funding for education, lagging behind states like West Virginia and Kentucky. At the same time, President Trump’s administration is dismantling the U.S. Department of Education and cutting funding for critical programs like Title I and special education.<br /> <br /> In Congress, James is opposing efforts to dismantle the Department of Education, and supports fully funding IDEA and Title I, and expanding support for military-connected students through the federal Impact Aid program. He is committed to making college more affordable, increasing access to workforce and technical training programs, and addressing the student loan crisis by supporting policies that reduce student debt and provide relief for borrowers. Additionally, he supports initiatives to expand early childhood education, invest in high-quality teacher training, and reduce inequities in school funding to ensure that every child has the opportunity to succeed." /> Skip to Content Education Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Congressman Walkinshaw is a proud graduate of Northern Virginia public schools and knows that strong public education is the foundation of a thriving community and economy. Affordability | U.S. Representative James Walkinshaw <br /> In Congress, James opposes harmful tariffs imposed under the Trump administration, which have increased costs for businesses and consumers alike. He is advocating for policies to lower the cost of prescription drugs, including empowering Medicare to negotiate drug prices and capping out-of-pocket costs for seniors. He also supports investments in domestic manufacturing and supply chains to reduce price volatility, strengthen the economy, and create good-paying jobs in Northern Virginia and across the nation. James is committed to protecting families from inflation, expanding economic opportunity, and building a resilient economy that benefits all Americans, not just the top one percent." /> Skip to Content Affordability Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Congressman Walkinshaw knows that families in Virginia’s 11th District are feeling the pressure of rising costs, higher grocery bills, gas prices, and health care expenses are stretching household budgets. He believes that the government must act to ease these burdens and ensure that our economy works for working families. James understands families are facing skyrocketing gas prices and utility bills. That's why he cosponsored the Energy Bills Relief Act.  In Congress, James opposes harmful tariffs imposed under the Trump administration, which have increased costs for businesses and consumers alike. He is advocating for policies to lower the cost of prescription drugs, including empowering Medicare to negotiate drug prices and capping out-of-pocket costs for seniors. He also supports investments in domestic manufacturing and supply chains to reduce price volatility, strengthen the economy, and create good-paying jobs in Northern Virginia and across the nation. James is committed to protecting families from inflation, expanding economic opportunity, and building a resilient economy that benefits all Americans, not just the top one percent. Affordable Housing | U.S. Representative James Walkinshaw <br /> In Congress, James supports the Road to Housing Act, comprehensive legislation to cut red tape, modernize environmental reviews, expand manufactured housing, and empower HUD to work more flexibly with local communities." /> Skip to Content Affordable Housing Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Congressman Walkinshaw believes every working family deserves a safe, affordable place to call home. He recognizes that the housing crisis in Fairfax and across the nation is not just a local problem but a national emergency. He has already taken bold steps locally — converting an underused county-owned parking lot into 279 units of affordable housing plus a childcare center, supporting the dedication of a real-estate tax penny to fund affordable housing, and pushing for zoning and permitting reforms to increase housing supply. In Congress, James supports the Road to Housing Act, comprehensive legislation to cut red tape, modernize environmental reviews, expand manufactured housing, and empower HUD to work more flexibly with local communities.

Climate Change | U.S. Representative James Walkinshaw <br /> In Congress, James supports bold federal action to mobilize federal investments in cheap clean energy, climate resilience, and green jobs. He is also fighting to secure expanded funding for the Chesapeake Bay Restoration Program to accelerate cleanup of one of our nation’s most vital waterways. Walkinshaw opposes reckless efforts to expand offshore drilling that threaten our coasts, our environment, and our economy -- which is why he cosponsored the Defend our Coast Act. <br /> <br /> He is also working to repeal the anti-climate provisions of Trump’s so-called “Big Beautiful Bill,” including rollbacks on clean energy tax credits and incentives that will undermine America’s transition to renewable energy and drive up utility costs for hardworking families." /> Skip to Content Climate Change Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Congressman Walkinshaw knows that confronting climate change is a defining challenge, and an opportunity to build a cleaner, healthier, more prosperous future. On the Fairfax County Board of Supervisors, he delivered on his commitment to make Fairfax carbon neutral and helped lead efforts to install solar on County buildings, convert the vehicle fleet to electric, and empower residents and businesses to reduce their carbon footprint. He spearheaded the County’s five-cent plastic bag fee, raising millions for litter prevention while slashing plastic pollution, and advanced the County’s Zero Waste initiative to cut landfill waste and embed sustainability into every part of local government. In Congress, James supports bold federal action to mobilize federal investments in cheap clean energy, climate resilience, and green jobs. He is also fighting to secure expanded funding for the Chesapeake Bay Restoration Program to accelerate cleanup of one of our nation’s most vital waterways. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to restore and modernize protections of the <a href="https://sewell.house.gov/2025/3/rep-sewell-introduces-the-john-r-lewis-voting-rights-advancement-act-ahead-of-the-60th-anniversary-of-bloody-sunday?utm_source=chatgpt.com" target="_blank">Voting Rights Act</a>. The executive branch has repeatedly flouted court orders, bypassed due process, and threatened the foundational norms that sustain our republic. Congress must reassert its Constitutional authority and provide a check on the President. As Chair of the Fairfax County Board’s Legislative Committee, Walkinshaw led efforts to expand early voting access, defend voting rights, and oppose suppression efforts out of Richmond. In Congress, James is a cosponsor of the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to restore and modernize protections of the Voting Rights Act . He also supports legislation to protect against partisan gerrymandering, guard election workers from harassment, and advance ethics, transparency, and accountability reforms, including the Protecting Our Democracy Act. Economy | U.S. Representative James Walkinshaw <br /> Northern Virginia is one of the most dynamic and innovative regions in the country, and Congressman Walkinshaw is committed to keeping it competitive. He has led regional efforts to attract high-quality jobs, invest in critical infrastructure like rail and broadband, and support next-generation technologies—including Artificial Intelligence (AI), space and quantum technologies, and blockchain—while advocating for modern, risk-based regulatory frameworks that encourage innovation and prevent abuse.<br /> <br /> In Congress, James is fighting to protect the Northern Virginia economy from federal mismanagement and reckless policies, including the Trump-led Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) cuts, draconian budget reductions, and tariffs that threaten businesses and workers. He is pushing for continued federal investments in infrastructure, research, and workforce development, recognizing that these are essential to sustaining economic growth, innovation, and opportunity in Northern Virginia and across the nation.<br /> <br /> Congressman Walkinshaw is committed to ensuring that Northern Virginia remains a hub of economic opportunity, innovation, and prosperity, standing up to policies that threaten the region’s workforce, investments, and long-term competitiveness." /> Skip to Content Economy Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Congressman Walkinshaw has dedicated his career to protecting and growing Northern Virginia’s economy. As Chief of Staff to Congressman Gerry Connolly, he helped secure millions in federal funding for Fairfax County and safeguarded the region’s federal workforce, a cornerstone of the local economy. On the Fairfax County Board of Supervisors, he supported small businesses during the COVID-19 pandemic with critical grants and worked to ensure local families and workers could recover from economic disruptions. Northern Virginia is one of the most dynamic and innovative regions in the country, and Congressman Walkinshaw is committed to keeping it competitive. Equality | U.S. Representative James Walkinshaw <br /> In Congress, James is a cosponsor of the Equality Act, which expands federal non-discrimination protections to include sexual orientation and gender identity in employment, housing, education, public accommodations, and federally funded programs. He is an advocate of updating the Fair Housing Act to explicitly prohibit discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity and push for stronger enforcement of Title IX on college and university campuses to prevent harassment and ensure safe, equitable educational environments. James is committed to fighting for policies that protect civil rights, advance equality, and ensure that every American can live and work free from discrimination." /> Skip to Content Equality Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Print this Page Share by Email Congressman Walkinshaw believes every person deserves to be treated with dignity and respect. As a leader in Fairfax County, he helped the community earn a perfect 100 out of 100 on the Human Rights Campaign’s Municipal Equality Index, reflecting its strong commitment to inclusion, civil rights, and equal opportunity. In Congress, James is a cosponsor of the Equality Act, which expands federal non-discrimination protections to include sexual orientation and gender identity in employment, housing, education, public accommodations, and federally funded programs. He is an advocate of updating the Fair Housing Act to explicitly prohibit discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity and push for stronger enforcement of Title IX on college and university campuses to prevent harassment and ensure safe, equitable educational environments. James is committed to fighting for policies that protect civil rights, advance equality, and ensure that every American can live and work free from discrimination. Federal Employees | U.S. Representative James Walkinshaw <br /> On his first day in Congress, James introduced the Limit on Sweeping Executive Reorganization Act, legislation requiring any President who seeks to cut the federal workforce by five percent or an agency budget by ten percent to first come to Congress for an up or down vote. He also co-sponsored the Delete DOGE Act to repeal the Trump administration’s dangerous effort to hollow out the civil service and undermine the professionalism of federal employees.<br /> <br /> James has cosponsored legislation to strengthen protections, benefits, and workplace fairness for federal employees.
